claims.value: Hormayr’s account gives Bisson’s marching column more than 3,000 men before Innsbruck, distinct from the combined garrison/capitulation population.
claims.rationale: Marching column; preceding/following text lists Bavarian attachments separately. Not all local defenders. English rendering (ours): "More than 3,000 men under Divisional-General Bisson."

citations.locator: hormayr, printed p. 232, Internet Archive leaf 239; inspected page-image excerpt
citations.quote: mehr als 3000 Mann unter dem Divisions-General Bisson

claims.value: Hormayr describes more than 20,000 armed countrymen surrounding the column, against Bodart’s 15,000 Landsturm.
claims.rationale: Narrative surrounding population, not verified simultaneous engaged strength. English rendering (ours): "Surrounded on all sides by more than 20,000 armed countrymen."

citations.locator: hormayr, printed p. 234, Internet Archive leaf 241; inspected page-image excerpt
citations.quote: auf allen Seiten umstellt durch mehr als 20,000 bewaffnete und erbitterte Landleute

claims.value: Pelet also reports more than 20,000 Tyrolese assailing the recruits.
claims.rationale: Interested opponent estimate; agreement with Hormayr may be dependence and is not independent corroboration. English rendering (ours): "More than 20,000 Tyrolese assail his recruit battalions."

citations.locator: pelet3, printed p. 90, Internet Archive leaf 97; inspected page-image excerpt
citations.quote: Plus de 20,000 Tyroliens assaillent ses bataillons de recrues

claims.value: Hormayr assigns the imposed capitulation terms to Major Teimer.
claims.rationale: Narrative above printed capitulation; document itself dated 13 April on this image. No automatic attribution to every signatory. English rendering (ours): "Under the capitulation which Major Teimer authoritatively prescribed."

citations.locator: hormayr, printed p. 234, Internet Archive leaf 241; inspected page-image excerpt
citations.quote: nach der Capitulation, welche Major Teimer gebieterisch vorschrieb

claims.value: Pelet says reports placed Chasteler absent from the 12–13 April actions.
claims.rationale: Source-qualified absence, not a resolved authority boundary. English rendering (ours): "This general, whom the order names Chadeler, did not attend the actions of 12 and 13 April according to the reports."

citations.locator: pelet3, printed p. 89, Internet Archive leaf 96; inspected page-image excerpt
citations.quote: Ce général (que l’ordre nomme Chadeler) n’assistait pas, d’après les rapports, aux affaires des 12 et 13 avril

claims.value: Pelet attributes the surrender decision to Bisson.
claims.rationale: Subject identified on preceding inspected page. Rhetorical exclamation omitted; no skill judgment. English rendering (ours): "The general laid down arms before peasants."

citations.locator: pelet3, printed p. 90, Internet Archive leaf 97; inspected page-image excerpt
citations.quote: Le général mit bas les armes devant des paysans

claims.value: Pelet describes spring floods swelling the Inn at the capitulation.
claims.rationale: English rendering (ours): "To cross the Inn, swollen by spring floods."

citations.locator: pelet3, printed p. 90, Internet Archive leaf 97; inspected page-image excerpt

claims.value: Hormayr describes blocked roads, cut tracks and partly or wholly destroyed bridges during the column’s retreat.
claims.rationale: Approach/retreat constraints, not a numerical readiness score. English rendering (ours): "The road blocked in many places, the tracks dug up, bridges and footbridges wholly or partly torn down."
